level.desc.beginner: Reacts slowly and leaves openings to counter.
level.desc.normal: Mixes attacks, defence and jumps; uses its techniques and punishes some mistakes.
level.desc.hard: Judges distance, guards and punishes often.
level.desc.expert: Reacts fast, reads high/low, chains combos and manages Resonance. No cheating: it plays by your rules.
arcade.desc: Defeat the other three warriors in best-of-3 fights; the last rival is tougher and fights in the Arena of Balance. You have {n} continues: each one costs points.
survival.desc: Single-round fights against endless opponents. You only recover part of your health between fights and the difficulty rises every {n} wins. The run ends at your first defeat.
versus.controls: Same keyboard — P1: A/D move · W jump · S crouch · F G H light/medium/heavy · R special (→+R / ↓+R / R in the air: elemental bending) · T Resonance · F+G throw · walk back or left Shift = guard. P2: arrows · numpad 1 2 3 (or , . -) light/medium/heavy · 4 (or L) special and elemental bending · 5 (or ;) Resonance · 0 or right Shift = guard.
versus.ghost: Some keyboards cannot register several keys at once (ghosting). If a hit does not come out, use the alternative keys (, . - L ;) or an anti-ghosting keyboard.
versus.touch: Connect a keyboard (USB or Bluetooth) and press any key: 2-player mode unlocks instantly.
versus.same: Pick the same warrior for a mirror match: the second fighter wears an exclusive chroma.

story.intro: Follow the Balance tournament with {name}: three fights, each with its own dialogue.
story.prologue.1: For a thousand years the four elements lived in balance, held by the Seal that rests beneath the Arena of Balance.
story.prologue.2: Now the Seal is cracking: fire burns unchecked, the tides overflow, the earth trembles and the wind falls silent. Only the champion of the ancient tournament can renew it.
story.ignis.intro: My village burned the night the Seal failed. I won't let it happen again. I will win this tournament.
story.aqua.intro: The tides tell me of an imbalance deeper than any fight. I will watch, I will wait… and I will win.
story.terra.intro: My people have guarded the ruins of the Bastion for generations. If the earth gives way, I will be its wall.
story.zephyr.intro: A tournament to save the world… and everyone so serious. Someone has to remind them the wind can't be chained.
story.rival.ignis.pre: A rival who doesn't back down! I like that. Show me what fire you're made of.
story.rival.ignis.post: Good fight… Look after that Seal. If it burns, let it be for a good cause.
story.rival.aqua.pre: Stay calm. I already saw every one of your strikes in the water's reflection.
story.rival.aqua.post: You broke my rhythm. Then the current can still change.
story.rival.terra.pre: One more step and you won't pass. Stone isn't moved by force.
story.rival.terra.post: Your resolve is granite. Go on; the road is yours.
story.rival.zephyr.pre: Already here? I was almost bored. Catch me, if you can.
story.rival.zephyr.post: Well, you caught me. Go on; the wind knows how to lose, too.
story.ignis.ending: The Seal shines again. Ignis holds it in both hands and feels that fire, at last, obeys the heart and not the rage.
story.aqua.ending: The tides return to their course. Aqua smiles: calm was never waiting, it was knowing when to act.
story.terra.ending: The earth stops trembling. Terra rests a hand on the stone and swears the Bastion will never fall again.
story.zephyr.ending: The wind returns, light and free. Zephyr laughs: saving the world, in the end, can be fun too.
story.fin: THE END · The Balance holds… for now.

wpn.wp_cuchillos.power: Technique: throws three knives in a fan (high, middle and low). Pressure from range and combo finisher.
wpn.wp_boleadoras.power: Technique: spins them overhead and throws them in an arc; they entangle (long stun) and bring down jumpers.
wpn.wp_bumeran.power: Technique: throw it and it comes back to your hand; it hits on the way out and back while you keep attacking.
wpn.wp_daga.power: Counter technique: a dagger guard; if the opponent attacks (or shoots) right then, you parry and answer with a powered cut.
wpn.wp_daga.passive: Upgrade: cuts your elemental-triangle disadvantage by 30% and +5% defense.
wpn.wp_maza.power: Technique: an overhead smash that must be blocked standing, shatters guard and knocks down.
wpn.wp_abanico.power: Counter technique: a fan sweep that sends the opponent's projectiles back and blows them away.
wpn.wp_garfios.power: Technique: hooks the opponent at mid range and drags them to you; punishes zoners and opens combos.
wpn.wp_garfios.passive: Upgrade: cuts your elemental disadvantage by 25% and +5% damage.
wpn.wp_arco.power: Technique: draws the bow, pulls and fires a very fast, strong arrow; the bow fades away afterwards.
wpn.note: Each weapon is bought once and any warrior can equip it (one per warrior). It gives a technique on its own button (O · P1 E · P2 6) and an upgrade; normal attacks stay unarmed.
wpn.element: Adapts to your element: Fire +15% damage · Water stuns longer · Wind more reach, speed and push · Earth breaks more guard and absorbs one hit on startup.
wpn.none: No weapons yet: buy them in the Shop with Rose Gold.
guide.gbtip: slow: breaks a blocking opponent's guard; a quick hit interrupts it
guide.weapontip: equipped weapon technique (bought in the Shop)

story.ignis.vs.aqua: Your calm puts out nothing, Aqua. It only makes me want to burn brighter.
story.ignis.vs.terra: Mountains melt too. You're about to find out.
story.ignis.vs.zephyr: Run all you want. Fire knows how to fly too.
story.aqua.vs.ignis: Breathe deep, Ignis. A wildfire without control burns itself out.
story.aqua.vs.terra: Stone resists, yes. But I have all the patience of the sea.
story.aqua.vs.zephyr: No jokes this time, Zephyr. The Seal won't wait.
story.terra.vs.ignis: So much flame and so little foundation. Come, I'll teach you to plant your feet.
story.terra.vs.aqua: Water flows around rocks, Aqua. I'm not stepping aside.
story.terra.vs.zephyr: You can float all day. Sooner or later you'll touch my ground.
story.zephyr.vs.ignis: Are you always this angry? You could use a breeze.
story.zephyr.vs.aqua: Aqua! If I win, you teach me to surf your waves. Deal?
story.zephyr.vs.terra: A mountain, how scary! …Okay, it is a little scary.

story.arrive.cenizas: The Fortress of Ashes burns under a sky of embers. Rivers of lava cross the courtyard, meteors fall and the volcano never stops roaring.
story.arrive.mareas: At the Sanctuary of Tides the storm never ends: lightning lights up the sea and a waterspout spins on the horizon.
story.arrive.bastion: The Primordial Bastion rises among canyons and sand. The wind drags the dust storm and boulders float around the monolith.
story.arrive.viento: Snow falls over the Gardens of the Wind. Islands float among the clouds and a tornado keeps watch from afar.
story.arrive.equilibrio: The Arena of Balance. The four elements orbit the cracked Seal and the aurora trembles in the sky.
story.arrive.bosque: The Training Forest: the waterfall roars among the pines and the rain never stops.
